candidates.title: Cathedral Breached
candidates.hook: At E041-B0026 (00:41.00), Catherine projects derisively to the cathedral, 'Lady Juliana Ashcroft. Look around,' publicly parading a chained captive before high society.
candidates.cliffhanger: At E041-B0053, silhouetted armed figures emerge through the pulverized cathedral doors while Juliana's face fills with breathless awe, leaving unresolved who stormed the wedding and whether she will be rescued.
candidates.standalone_context: A cruel bride pauses her lavish nuptials to publicly humiliate a woman brought in chains, only for a massive detonation to demolish the church entrance as armed forces invade.
candidates.why_it_works: The sharp tonal pivot from aristocratic cruelty to explosive violence instantly hooks scrolling viewers and sets up an epic rescue.
candidates.concerns: The identities of the armed invaders remain obscured by smoke at the cut.

resolved_segments.end_text: Extreme close-up pushing in on Juliana's bruised face. Her expression shifts from grim resolve into awe, breathless realization, and blooming hope as the orchestral score swells into an abrupt cliffhanger.

candidates.title: The True Duke Returns
candidates.hook: At E042-B0009 and E042-B0010 (00:18.00), Rupert charges down the altar steps screaming frantically, 'Guards! Arrest this imposter!'
candidates.cliffhanger: At E042-B0036, Alexander rests his hand on his sabre and warns the trembling Rupert, 'And now, Rupert... we settle what you stole,' leaving Rupert cornered and awaiting retribution.
candidates.standalone_context: A frantic usurper attempts to arrest an intruder, but his royal guards refuse to obey because the newcomer is the presumed-dead rightful Duke, recognized and confirmed by his own mother.
candidates.why_it_works: The guards' immediate refusal to obey Rupert's command creates instant dramatic reversal, building momentum to an emotional maternal reunion and a promise of vengeance.

resolved_segments.start_text: Medium shot of Rupert descending the altar steps, furiously pointing toward Alexander.
resolved_segments.end_text: Tight close-up on Alexander, his hand resting on the hilt of his sabre as his eyes burn with fierce, cold retribution.

candidates.title: Treason in the Chapel
candidates.hook: At E043-B0056 and E043-B0057 (01:09.00), Alexander towers over Rupert and roars accusations across the hall: 'You sold my men to the enemy.'
candidates.cliffhanger: At E043-B0087, Lord Sterling throws open the chapel side exit only to be trapped by a police constable asking, 'Going somewhere, Lord Sterling?', cutting to black on his terrified face.
candidates.standalone_context: Alexander confronts Rupert with Crown military intelligence proving Rupert and Sterling committed wartime treason to steal his ducal title, causing Rupert to betray Sterling, who tries to flee.
candidates.why_it_works: Shocking battlefield betrayal and official documentation force the conspirators against each other, ending on a thrilling intercepted escape.
candidates.concerns: Lord Sterling is not extensively introduced before his panicked flight, though his complicity is immediately clear.

resolved_segments.start_text: Low-angle shot on Alexander towering over the fallen Rupert.
resolved_segments.end_text: Extreme close-up on Lord Sterling's face frozen in pure terror, his jaw agape as his escape is completely cut off, holding until fade to black.

candidates.title: The Duke's Choice
candidates.hook: At E044-B0017 and E044-B0018 (00:25.20), Catherine abandons Rupert and rushes toward Alexander in her bridal gown, weeping, 'Alexander... I thought you had died.'
candidates.cliffhanger: At E044-B0053, Alexander bypasses the aristocratic bride and strides straight to the chained Juliana at the door, leaving Catherine gasping in horrified disbelief: 'Her?!'
candidates.standalone_context: The bride tries to salvage her position by claiming enduring love for the returning Duke, but he coldly rejects her superficial loyalty and walks toward a captive woman standing in chains.
candidates.why_it_works: A scathing romantic rejection subverts expectations when the Duke ignores the glamorous bride in favor of a chained outcast.

resolved_segments.start_text: Wide shot as Catherine gathers her heavy train and steps away from Rupert, walking toward Alexander who stands watching her stoically.
resolved_segments.end_text: Extreme close-up on Catherine's horrified, bewildered expression as she realizes who Alexander chose.

candidates.title: Unlawful Duchess
candidates.hook: At E045-B0044 and E045-B0045 (01:02.60), Alexander condemns Catherine before the congregation: 'You hurt the two women who mattered most to me: my mother, and my wife.'
candidates.cliffhanger: At E045-B0073, the High Priest rules that Juliana is not Alexander's lawful wife for lack of a Crown license, leaving Juliana in terror while Catherine flashes a venomous smile.
candidates.standalone_context: Alexander stuns high society by presenting Juliana as his lawful Duchess, but the High Priest storms in with armed officers and revokes the union's legal standing on the spot.
candidates.why_it_works: A soaring public vindication is suddenly sabotaged by ecclesiastical law, instantly shifting the advantage back to the villain.

resolved_segments.start_text: Medium close-up of Alexander turning slightly toward the gathered congregation as his voice rings across the cathedral.
resolved_segments.end_text: Slow push-in close-up on Catherine beneath her veil, her initial despair morphing into a cold, venomous, triumphant smile as the episode cuts.
